reuse.why: Extends the existing shouldFillCategory/getFillCategories/getBudgetData path used by every month-wide action; the small goal_def parsing helper is local rather than shared with goal-template.ts, but no existing helper answers 'has saved templates' on a row.

duplication.why: The template rule is added once inside the shared predicate and the now-dead includeHidden flag is removed rather than duplicated.

placement.why: The rule sits in the shared fill predicate in budget/actions.ts, exactly where the tree decides which categories month-wide actions write.

scope.why: Only the fill predicate, its two queries and call-site arguments change.

maintainability.why: Clean single-point change; minor nits are the loose `goal_def?: unknown` typing instead of the DbCategory type and the defensive JSON.parse that treats malformed JSON as 'has templates'.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All month-wide actions (copyPreviousMonth, setZero, averages via getAverageFillCategories) keep going through shouldFillCategory.

disguised_duplication.where: No logic is copied; the hidden rule stays in one branch and the template rule is new.

one_place.where: shouldFillCategory in packages/loot-core/src/server/budget/actions.ts (hidden + group hidden + hasSavedTemplates), used by copyPreviousMonth, setZero and getAverageFillCategories.
